records.statement: The 21:12 UTC XRPL Dashboard identifies a third amendment, LendingProtocolV1_1, in voting; it adds closed-ended vaults and cash-basis accounting. The direct XRPLWin V1_1 vote page was inaccessible, so its exact vote count is unknown.

The XRPL Dashboard says the loan-broker board waits for LendingProtocol, SingleAssetVault and LendingProtocolV1_1 activation. Earlier two-amendment notes were incomplete about the third amendment; the core two remain below threshold and the board is not live.
